   uncontested world builds. Re-pin it on a seed that does collide, or

BUT MAKE THE SEARCH ITSELF THE MEASUREMENT, because the second half of that sentence -- "or delete it if none remains" -- is the author telling you the collision might disappear entirely, and you are the campaign most likely to have caused that. Founder collisions happen when two founders contest the same site. You removed 151 occupation records and redistributed roughly 340 between peoples. Fewer, sparser founders contest less.

So when you scan for a replacement seed, RECORD HOW HARD IT WAS. If collisions used to be common and you now scan hundreds of seeds to find one, the collision RATE has collapsed and that is a quantitative result about your epidemic's effect on settlement density -- a better one than any of the counts you have re-pinned tonight, because it is a rate rather than a snapshot. If you find one immediately, say that too; it bounds the effect from the other side.

Either way the number belongs in the chronicle beside the population table.

GATE PROGRESS, since it is worth knowing you are close: your gate has run 347s, 346s, 448s, 693s, 801s, 804s, 815s and now 824s before failing. A full green gate on this box is about 870s.
